Single-trial N400 amplitudes

Source: R/data.R
n400.Rd

30 participants read German sentences ending in an expected or unexpected word (Er trinkt seinen Kaffee / Schrank). For each trial, the mean EEG amplitude 300-500 ms after the final word at nine electrodes. The N400 is more negative the less predictable the word (lower cloze probability), and largest over centro-parietal sites. 80 items, two counterbalanced lists.

Usage

n400

Format

A tibble with 21600 rows and 9 columns:

participant

Participant ID, P01 to P30.

list

Counterbalancing list, 1 or 2.

item

Item ID, i01 to i80.

condition

"expected" or "unexpected".

cloze

Cloze probability of the final word.

electrode

"F3", "Fz", "F4", "C3", "Cz", "C4", "P3", "Pz" or "P4".

anteriority

"frontal", "central" or "parietal".

laterality

"left", "midline" or "right".

amplitude

Mean amplitude in microvolts.

Source

data-raw/n400.R

Details

True model: amplitude = 2 + p0 + i0 + e0 + weight * (-4 + p1) * (1 - cloze) + trial + e. The electrode weight is 1 at Pz, 0.85 to 0.9 at other parietal and central sites and 0.5 to 0.6 at frontal sites; e0 is a small electrode offset. By-participant intercepts p0 (SD 1.5) and N400 slopes p1 (SD 1); by-item intercepts i0 (SD 0.5); trial noise shared across electrodes (SD 4) and electrode noise (SD 3). Cloze is 0.5 to 0.95 for expected and 0 to 0.05 for unexpected words.

References

Kutas, M. & Hillyard, S. A. (1980). Reading senseless sentences: Brain potentials reflect semantic incongruity. Science, 207(4427), 203-205. doi:10.1126/science.7350657

Kutas, M. & Hillyard, S. A. (1984). Brain potentials during reading reflect word expectancy and semantic association. Nature, 307, 161-163. doi:10.1038/307161a0

Examples

head(n400)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 9
#>   participant  list item  condition cloze electrode anteriority laterality
#>   <fct>       <int> <fct> <fct>     <dbl> <fct>     <fct>       <fct>     
#> 1 P01             1 i01   expected   0.75 C3        central     left      
#> 2 P01             1 i01   expected   0.75 C4        central     right     
#> 3 P01             1 i01   expected   0.75 Cz        central     midline   
#> 4 P01             1 i01   expected   0.75 F3        frontal     left      
#> 5 P01             1 i01   expected   0.75 F4        frontal     right     
#> 6 P01             1 i01   expected   0.75 Fz        frontal     midline   
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: amplitude <dbl>
